vibe: Expensive, cinematic, moody, high-end 3D digital casino
design_philosophy: Blend human-centered UX with retro-futuristic luxury. Use deep emeralds, golds, and slate. Favor 3D immersive elements, glassmorphism, and high-performance interactive components.

headings.strategy: Use for game titles, welcome messages, and major section headers to evoke classic casino elegance. Apply tight tracking (tracking-tight) for sizes > 32px.

body.strategy: Use for dashboards, player stats, and general UI readability. High legibility geometric sans.

layout_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical SaaS designs to feel premium.
layout_spacing.containers: Always apply internal padding (p-6 or p-8) on bordered containers to prevent collision.

grids.lobby: Mode A (Tetris Grid) - Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12, wide gap-8 to gap-12. Asymmetry for game showcases.
grids.operator_panel: Mode B (Control Room Grid) - Dense, tight gap-4 or gap-6 for Texas Hold'em operator oversight.

surface_strategies.glassmorphism: Used for sticky headers, game overlays, and floating navs. backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#0B1021]/60 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)].
surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Flat background (#121A30), 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover adds shadow and slight lift.
surface_strategies.tracing_beam: Use for high-conversion actions or VIP/premium game tiers.

components_strategy.marketing_lobby: Custom HTML/Tailwind. Avoid Shadcn containers. Use raw div, section for overlapping/asymmetry.
components_strategy.dashboard_app: Use Shadcn UI (tables, dialogs, dropdowns) heavily customized to match the luxury dark theme (remove default Vercel look).
components_strategy.buttons: Primary CTAs should use Gold gradients (bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D4AF37] to-[#E5C05F] text-black) or 1px subtle solid borders for secondary actions. Always include hover states.

motion_interactions.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion_interactions.micro_interactions: Framer motion for tilting cards on mouse hover (physics-based easing).
motion_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Provide aria-hidden on decorative animations.

icons_assets.library: lucide-react for standard icons. Consider @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone) for high-end luxury feel.
icons_assets.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive and key informational elements (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='player-balance').

lobby_hero.description: People gambling at tables in a lavish casino. Use for immersive background or hero section with heavy black/blue overlay (bg-[#0B1021]/70).

slots_preview.description: Slot machines in a dimly lit casino at night. Great for game grid thumbnails.

blackjack_table.description: Casino interior with tables. Use for Blackjack or Table games thumbnail.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute full frontend redesign for high-end luxury digital casino.
Implement Playfair Display for headings and Manrope for body text (import via Google Fonts).
Convert all game lobbies and Texas Hold'em Operator dashboard to the dark Jewel & Luxury theme.
Ensure operator dashboards use dense, data-heavy grid layouts while the casino lobby uses asymmetric visual grids.
Apply 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms for test automation.
Use provided Unsplash images for thumbnails/backgrounds. Apply heavy gradient overlays if placing text on top of images.
Avoid Shadcn 'Card' wrappers on marketing pages—use raw Tailwind for custom layouts.
Modify Shadcn components to remove the default look, replacing borders and backgrounds with the luxury palette.
Security is explicitly out of scope for this pass as requested; focus entirely on UX, UI, and performance smoothness.
Files are in .js, not .tsx. Ensure all component implementations respect the .js extension and proper PropTypes or JS-friendly structures.
